title: Burrito bowl with beans
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 240 ml salted water for 15 minutes, then let it rest.
Rinse the beans and warm them with the sweetcorn, cumin, paprika and 3 tbsp water in a pot for 5 minutes.
Finely dice the tomatoes and red onion and mix with lime juice, salt and chopped coriander to make a salsa.
Shred the lettuce and slice the avocado.
Arrange the quinoa, beans, lettuce, salsa and avocado side by side in bowls.
